A tall central brow crest shaped like a cracked black-metal war crown, centered between the eyes and rising backward.
Rows of oversized ivory fangs on all five open lower jaws, alternating long and short teeth. Add a dark red inner-mouth plate behind each row.

Paint broad faded war scars and blackened slash marks across the charcoal hide, especially along the flanks and rump. Preserve the bronze plates.
Add a segmented warm gray belly pattern with irregular vertical armored bands, darker between segments and subtly weathered.
Paint ritual red war-paint stripes across the central brow and cheek ridges, with smaller matching marks on the four side heads.
